title: Dungeon descent
tagline: Descend a dungeon, one careful step at a time.
teaser: A turn-based descent through dungeon levels full of creatures, items and secrets. Every run is new and every choice matters.

manPage.synopsis: hack — explore each level, pick your fights, and go ever deeper.
manPage.description: Jay Fenlason wrote the original hack with Kenny Woodland, Mike Thome and Jon Payne; Andries Brouwer at CWI Amsterdam reworked it into an almost entirely new game.

howToPlay: Explore each dungeon level one step at a time.
Pick up items and choose your fights carefully.
Go deeper and deeper and see how far you get.
